json_profile.numbers: integers excluding bool or canonical decimal strings only

strategy_definition_lineage.history_authority: CoreHost only; history fields forbidden in requests

denial_mapping_rule: every allowed denial maps to denial_event_by_operation[operation]; no fallback

denial_code_registry.REQUEST_SCHEMA_INVALID: request schema or constrained type invalid
denial_code_registry.MARKET_DATA_ROUTE_NOT_READY: market readiness absent or not ready
denial_code_registry.EXECUTION_ROUTE_NOT_READY: execution readiness absent or not ready

compatibility_policy.selection: explicit IDs only and map-order independent

capabilities.product: required product capabilities subset of ExecutionRoute.route_capability_ceiling intersect ProductCapabilities.capability_set
capabilities.account_permissions: required account permissions subset of AccountCapabilitySnapshot.permission_set intersect CredentialProfile.permission_snapshot when required

m04_m05_projection_policy.M0.4: ProductCapabilities environment projection uses environment, trust_state, capability_set and private_execution_allowed semantics
M0.5: ExchangeAccount fields retain exact M0.5 names and readiness semantics
Instrument catalog_snapshot_id and source_adapter_family_id exact scope

invariants: display name and symbol are not identity
unknown enum, malformed nested object, bad ID or bool integer denies
all context records validated before lookup
denial returns immutable decision with no storage mutation
route selection independent of map order
PUBLIC market data grants no execution authority

capability_authority_model.product_rule: required product capabilities subset of ExecutionRoute.route_capability_ceiling intersect ProductCapabilities.capability_set
capability_authority_model.account_permission_rule: required account permissions subset of validated AccountCapabilitySnapshot.permission_set

trusted_context_cross_record_invariants.DRAFT: zero or one route binding; two is invalid
trusted_context_cross_record_invariants.active_strategy_instances: exact set of IDs whose records are ACTIVE; all IDs exist; duplicates forbidden

validated_account_capability_snapshot_pr.source: Core-owned result of complete M0.5 snapshot and lineage validation

credential_profile_projection_policy.source: Core-owned validated M0.5 CredentialProfile metadata; no secret fields

authorization_dependencies_match_policy: exact set equality with authorization_dependencies_by_environment[environment] for BIND_EXECUTION_ROUTE and ACTIVATE_STRATEGY_INSTANCE

relationships: StrategyInstance -> definition/account/universe/non-null routes with exact ownership/version
Account -> exact snapshot and environment-dependent credential
Snapshot <-> exact account plus temporal invariants
RouteReadiness -> existing route of matching kind

paper_credential_policy.PAPER: active_credential_profile_id may be null; no profile required

definition_version_resolution_policy.history_version_lifecycle: an existing instance may validate/readiness/activate only when its exact historical version remains ACTIVE
definition_version_resolution_policy.new_instance_policy: only the current ACTIVE version may be used for CREATE_STRATEGY_INSTANCE
definition_version_resolution_policy.existing_instance_policy: an existing instance pinned to an earlier ACTIVE version remains valid and is never redirected to current

trading_universe_catalog_membership_poli.set_equality: source_catalog_snapshot_ids equals the set of catalog_snapshot_id values used by all universe instruments
